name: Manager Agent Gym (MA-Gym)
description: MA-Gym is an open-source simulation and evaluation framework for testing autonomous manager agents in complex, collaborative project settings. It models workflows as graph-based multi-agent systems formally defined as Partially Observable Stochastic Games (POSGs), where a manager must decompose goals, allocate tasks to human and AI workers, monitor progress, and adapt to changing conditions. The initial release includes 20 diverse workflow scenarios drawn from real-world domains including finance, marketing, and healthcare.
reputation: Emerging framework; highlights significant trade-offs in simultaneously optimizing goal completion, constraint adherence, and workflow runtime for GPT-5-based manager agents.
notes: Action space includes observability-increasing actions, graph-modifying actions, and delegation/communication actions. Modeled as a POSG to capture partial observability and multi-agent dynamics. GPT-5-based agents showed significant trade-offs across objectives.
